entries.title: Planes

violence.summary: Flying peril includes near-crashes, storm danger, going underwater, a train tunnel close call, sabotage injuries, and a flashback to fighter planes being shot down.

language.summary: Dialogue includes mild insults and a vehicle-themed crude phrase.

romance.summary: Planes flirt, serenade, use affectionate nicknames, show kiss marks, and make one mild backside-focused remark.

drinking.summary: CSM mentions a disqualifying fuel enhancer but does not label it as drinking, drug, or smoking content.

handoffNotes: CSM labels Drinking, Drugs & Smoking as not present while the detail text mentions a competition-disqualifying fuel enhancer.

entries.title: Planes: Fire & Rescue

violence.summary: Frequent wildfire peril includes characters trapped by fire, smoke and embers, crash landings, river rapids near a waterfall, an old-mine entrapment with suffocation fear, serious heat damage, a memorial to a dead friend, and a fire caused by a rough landing.

language.summary: Vehicle-themed fake swears, a few insults, and mild gas humor are noted.

romance.summary: Romance jokes include an aggressive crush, date and room-sharing comments, mild body-part innuendo, pickup flirting, and an older couple discussing their engagement.

drinking.summary: Vehicle characters socialize in bar-like settings with oil cans treated like drinks, plus a mock cocktail reference.

handoffNotes: Wildfire peril, fear of suffocation, serious damage, and a past death may need prose context.

entries.title: Treasure Island

violence.summary: Pirate violence includes shootings, a close-range face shooting, stabbings, and a knife injury to the boy hero.

language.summary: CSM does not surface actual profanity, aside from a joke that a parrot may repeat bad language.

romance.summary: CSM does not surface a meaningful sex, romance, or nudity concern.

drinking.summary: Seamen drink heavily, one drunken sailor is manipulated into a fatal fall overboard, and Billy Bones is implied to die from alcohol abuse.

handoffNotes: Alcohol-linked death and deliberate intoxication used as murder may need prose context.
